body:
Founder real-time: 'i want there to be a plane by default that the player collides with - the checkerboard in the level editor - that should constitute the plane for that level - configurable in terms of size... turn on able and off able per level' / 'the squares are always the same size' / 'so the units needs to be the number of squares in the grid.' New Level.GroundPlaneEnabled/GroundPlaneSquares, real persisted fields threaded through Create/Update/Export/Clone + a new migration (ALTER TABLE -- the original create-table migration was already live, kept untouched). GridCellSize=50.0 matched directly against SHANKPIT's own real, already-existing GRID_SIZE=50.0f floor-grid/magenta-glow-trail convention rather than an arbitrary constant. Frontend: checkbox + squares input, a real 3D-viewport grid driven by these fields (divisions === squares, always-square cells). 2 new Go tests. Live-verified against the real running server: migration applied, API carries the fields, pre-existing rows correctly backfilled. Built, deployed, bundle-presence verified before Go rebuild. Commit e0f735e.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-08: real, per-level, configurable ground plane (SHANKPIT NOCK editor)
